Vivid, beautiful, and ideal for skewering. Looks like a toy, but its lethality is no joke.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Very Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee Weapon • Range: Melee

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: While this weapon’s user has active Optical Camo, FBC Chameleon Coating, or an M97 Ghostsuit, all attacks from this weapon (including those which break the camo/stealth) have the effect of Hyper Expansive Ammunition. Additionally, when causing a Critical Injury with this weapon, in addition to the regular effects and Bonus Damage, for 9 seconds (3 Rounds) the victim’s MOVE and DEX is reduced by 2, and they cannot take the Run or Jump Move Actions.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
